name: Photo
description: Just the photo, edge to edge, cropped to the post shape, with an optional small white note in the bottom-left corner. New in kp-skills; not in the old app.
bestFor: the picture slides of a carousel
a single photo post cropped to the right shape
photoTip: Set the focus so the important part stays in the crop; landscape photos lose their sides in 4:5.

tones.note: The tone only shows if the photo is missing.

fields.label: Note
fields.hint: Optional small white text, bottom-left. Usually left empty.
